en-US.author: Posit Software, PBC
en-US.longDescription: An R formatter and language server, written in Rust.
en-US.name: Air
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Air no longer utilizes tree-sitter-r for parsing R files. Instead, Air now ships with a completely custom R parser written entirely in Rust. This comes with a number of benefits!
  - Air is now roughly 2x faster. Formatting all of dplyr has gone from 300ms to 150ms on an M2 Mac. The actual parsing stage is around 7x faster.
  - Air now emits precise error messages when a file fails to parse due to syntax errors.
  - Air no longer has C in its dependency chain. This means that we'll be able to add WASM support for Air much easier now.
  - If you are building a Rust based project that needs to parse R files, we encourage you to use our air_r_parser crate (pinned to a git SHA since we haven't put it on crates.io yet).
- We've fixed a number of minor issues through the new parser:
  - Air more accurately accepts certain syntax:
    - r"|...|", which are raw strings using the undocumented | delimiter
    - %a\b% where previously the \ failed to parse
    - for loops with ... or ..1 as the loop variable, like
      for (... in x)
    - Unary ? and ~ now have correct precedence when mixed with their binary counterparts (#565).
  - Air more accurately rejects certain syntax errors:
    - 1 2, which are two expressions side by side without a semicolon or newline
    - Stray top-level ;
    - pkg:: without a right-hand side
    - x$1 where the right-hand side is not an identifier
    - = assignment where R doesn't allow it, i.e. in argument values, parameter defaults, if and while conditions, and for loop sequences (#563)
- Air now emits much improved diagnostics at the command line. In particular, syntax errors in both R files and your air.toml are reported with a code frame that shows the exact location of the issue (#558):
  > air format .
  R/arrange.R:137:13 parse ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    ✖ Expected a loop sequence but instead found ')'.
      135 │   names(cols) <- as.character(seq_dots)
      136 │
    > 137 │   for (i in ) {
          │             ^
      138 │     name <- vec_paste0("..", i)
      139 │     dot <- dots[[i]]
  R/case-when.R:301:5 parse ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    ✖ Expected `,` but instead found `values`.
      299 │   .size <- case_when_size_common(
      300 │     conditions = conditions
    > 301 │     values = values,
          │     ^^^^^^
      302 │     size = .size
      303 │   )
  format ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    ✖ Found 2 errors.
  And for an air.toml issue:
  > air format . --check
  air.toml:2:15 configuration ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    ✖ unknown variant `aut`, expected one of `auto`, `lf`, `crlf`, `native`
      1 │ [format]
    > 2 │ line-ending = "aut"
        │               ^^^^^
  format ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
    ✖ Found 1 error.
- Air no longer emits colored output when stderr is not a terminal, such as when stderr is redirected to a file.
